variables.input:
metrics 
| filter metric.key == "ship.info"
| filter isNotNull(ship_id)
| fields ship_id
| dedup ship_id

hdr_overview.content:
## ⚓ Halifax-Class Frigate Fleet — Live Telemetry
Use the **Ship** dropdown above to filter to one or more ships. All tiles update live every 3 seconds.

tile_ship_map.title: Ship Positions — Live Map
tile_ship_map.query:
timeseries {
  latitude  = avg(`ship.latitude`),
  longitude = avg(`ship.longitude`)
}, by: {ship_id}, from: now()-5m
| filter isNull(array($ship)[0]) or in(ship_id, array($ship))
| fields ship_id,
         latitude  = arrayLast(latitude),
         longitude = arrayLast(longitude),
         ship_num  = toLong(subString(ship_id, from: 5))

tile_drone_map.title: Drone Positions — Live Map
tile_drone_map.query:
timeseries {
  latitude  = avg(`drone.latitude`),
  longitude = avg(`drone.longitude`)
}, by: {drone_id, ship_id}, from: now()-5m
| filter isNull(array($ship)[0]) or in(ship_id, array($ship))
| fields drone_id, ship_id,
         latitude  = arrayLast(latitude),
         longitude = arrayLast(longitude),
         ship_num  = toLong(subString(ship_id, from: 5))

tile_combat_readiness.title: Combat Readiness Snapshot
tile_combat_readiness.query:
timeseries {
  hull     = avg(`ship.dc.hull.integrity.percent`),
  bofors   = avg(`ship.weapons.bofors.ammo.rounds`),
  cisws    = avg(`ship.weapons.cisws.ammo.rounds`),
  harpoon  = avg(`ship.weapons.harpoon.ready`),
  vls      = avg(`ship.weapons.vls.cells.ready`),
  torpedo  = avg(`ship.weapons.torpedoes.ready`),
  contacts = avg(`ship.sonar.contacts.tracked`),
  air_trk  = avg(`ship.radar.air.tracks`),
  esm      = avg(`ship.radar.esm.alert`)
}, by: {ship_id}, from: now()-5m
| filter isNull(array($ship)[0]) or in(ship_id, array($ship))
| fields ship_id,
         hull_integrity_pct = arrayLast(hull),
         bofors_ammo        = arrayLast(bofors),
         cisws_ammo         = arrayLast(cisws),
         harpoon_ready      = arrayLast(harpoon),
         vls_cells_ready    = arrayLast(vls),
         torpedoes_ready    = arrayLast(torpedo),
         sonar_contacts     = arrayLast(contacts),
         air_tracks         = arrayLast(air_trk),
         esm_alert          = arrayLast(esm)

tile_navigation.title: Speed & Heading

tile_crew.title: Crew & Assigned Drones

tile_updates.title: Telemetry Update Rate
tile_updates.query:
timeseries count(`ship.speed.knots`), by: {ship_id}
| filter isNull(array($ship)[0]) or in(ship_id, array($ship))

hdr_dc.content:
## 🛡️ Damage Control
Hull integrity · Zone integrity (Bow→Stern) · Roll / Pitch / Heel · Stability · Fire & flood detection

tile_hull_integrity.title: Hull Integrity %
tile_hull_integrity.query:
timeseries hull = avg(`ship.dc.hull.integrity.percent`), by: {ship_id}
| filter isNull(array($ship)[0]) or in(ship_id, array($ship))

tile_hull_zones.title: Hull Structural Zones (Bow → Stern)

tile_roll_pitch.title: Sea State — Roll / Pitch / Heel

tile_dc_raw.title: Damage Control — Current Values
tile_dc_raw.query:
timeseries {
  hull    = avg(`ship.dc.hull.integrity.percent`),
  roll    = avg(`ship.dc.roll.degrees`),
  pitch   = avg(`ship.dc.pitch.degrees`),
  heel    = avg(`ship.dc.heel.degrees`),
  firez   = avg(`ship.dc.fire.zones`),
  floodz  = avg(`ship.dc.flood.zones`),
  ingress = avg(`ship.dc.water.ingress.lpm`),
  gm      = avg(`ship.dc.stability.gm.meters`),
  disp    = avg(`ship.dc.stability.displacement.tonnes`),
  co2     = avg(`ship.dc.fire.co2.pressure.bar`)
}, by: {ship_id}, from: now()-5m
| filter isNull(array($ship)[0]) or in(ship_id, array($ship))
| fields ship_id,
         hull_integrity_pct  = arrayLast(hull),
         roll_deg            = arrayLast(roll),
         pitch_deg           = arrayLast(pitch),
         heel_deg            = arrayLast(heel),
         fire_zones_active   = arrayLast(firez),
         flood_zones_active  = arrayLast(floodz),
         water_ingress_lpm   = arrayLast(ingress),
         gm_meters           = arrayLast(gm),
         displacement_tonnes = arrayLast(disp),
         co2_pressure_bar    = arrayLast(co2)

hdr_propulsion.content:
## ⚙️ Propulsion — CODOG Plant
2× GE LM2500 Gas Turbines · SEMT Pielstick Diesel · Controllable-pitch propeller shafts

tile_engine_plant.title: Engine Plant Output %

tile_gt_detail.title: Gas Turbine Detail — Temps & Vibration
tile_gt_detail.query:
timeseries {
  gt1_exhaust   = avg(`ship.propulsion.gt1.exhaust.temp.celsius`),
  gt2_exhaust   = avg(`ship.propulsion.gt2.exhaust.temp.celsius`),
  gt1_oil_temp  = avg(`ship.propulsion.gt1.oil.temp.celsius`),
  gt2_oil_temp  = avg(`ship.propulsion.gt2.oil.temp.celsius`),
  gt1_oil_pres  = avg(`ship.propulsion.gt1.oil.pressure.bar`),
  gt2_oil_pres  = avg(`ship.propulsion.gt2.oil.pressure.bar`),
  gt1_vibration = avg(`ship.propulsion.gt1.vibration.mms`),
  gt2_vibration = avg(`ship.propulsion.gt2.vibration.mms`),
  gt1_comp_rpm  = avg(`ship.propulsion.gt1.compressor.rpm`),
  gt2_comp_rpm  = avg(`ship.propulsion.gt2.compressor.rpm`)
}, by: {ship_id}
| filter isNull(array($ship)[0]) or in(ship_id, array($ship))

tile_propulsion_raw.title: Propulsion — Current Values
tile_propulsion_raw.query:
timeseries {
  gt1      = avg(`ship.propulsion.gt1.percent`),
  gt2      = avg(`ship.propulsion.gt2.percent`),
  diesel   = avg(`ship.propulsion.diesel.percent`),
  port_rpm = avg(`ship.propulsion.port.shaft.rpm`),
  stbd_rpm = avg(`ship.propulsion.stbd.shaft.rpm`),
  gbox_t   = avg(`ship.propulsion.gearbox.temp.celsius`),
  fuel     = avg(`ship.propulsion.fuel.consumption.lph`),
  gt1_exh  = avg(`ship.propulsion.gt1.exhaust.temp.celsius`),
  gt2_exh  = avg(`ship.propulsion.gt2.exhaust.temp.celsius`),
  gt1_vib  = avg(`ship.propulsion.gt1.vibration.mms`)
}, by: {ship_id}, from: now()-5m
| filter isNull(array($ship)[0]) or in(ship_id, array($ship))
| fields ship_id,
         gt1_pct              = arrayLast(gt1),
         gt2_pct              = arrayLast(gt2),
         diesel_pct           = arrayLast(diesel),
         port_shaft_rpm       = arrayLast(port_rpm),
         stbd_shaft_rpm       = arrayLast(stbd_rpm),
         gearbox_temp_c       = arrayLast(gbox_t),
         fuel_consumption_lph = arrayLast(fuel),
         gt1_exhaust_c        = arrayLast(gt1_exh),
         gt2_exhaust_c        = arrayLast(gt2_exh),
         gt1_vibration_mms    = arrayLast(gt1_vib)

tile_shafts.title: Propeller Shafts — RPM, Torque, Bearing Temps
tile_shafts.query:
timeseries {
  port_rpm       = avg(`ship.propulsion.port.shaft.rpm`),
  stbd_rpm       = avg(`ship.propulsion.stbd.shaft.rpm`),
  port_torque    = avg(`ship.propulsion.port.shaft.torque.knm`),
  stbd_torque    = avg(`ship.propulsion.stbd.shaft.torque.knm`),
  port_bearing   = avg(`ship.propulsion.port.shaft.bearing.temp.celsius`),
  stbd_bearing   = avg(`ship.propulsion.stbd.shaft.bearing.temp.celsius`),
  port_vibration = avg(`ship.propulsion.port.shaft.vibration.mms`),
  stbd_vibration = avg(`ship.propulsion.stbd.shaft.vibration.mms`)
}, by: {ship_id}
| filter isNull(array($ship)[0]) or in(ship_id, array($ship))

tile_diesel_detail.title: Diesel Engine Detail — Temps & Turbocharger

  bus_voltage   = avg(`ship.power.bus.voltage.volts`),
  frequency     = avg(`ship.power.frequency.hz`),
  phase1_v      = avg(`ship.power.bus.phase1.voltage.volts`),
  phase2_v      = avg(`ship.power.bus.phase2.voltage.volts`),
  phase3_v      = avg(`ship.power.bus.phase3.voltage.volts`),

tile_power_raw.title: Power — Current Values
tile_power_raw.query:
timeseries {
  g1kw  = avg(`ship.power.gen1.kw`),
  g2kw  = avg(`ship.power.gen2.kw`),
  g3kw  = avg(`ship.power.gen3.kw`),
  g4kw  = avg(`ship.power.gen4.kw`),
  total = avg(`ship.power.total.load.kw`),

  freq  = avg(`ship.power.frequency.hz`),

}, by: {ship_id}, from: now()-5m
| filter isNull(array($ship)[0]) or in(ship_id, array($ship))
| fields ship_id,

         gen3_kw           = arrayLast(g3kw),

hdr_sonar.content:
## 🔊 Sonar Systems
AN/SQS-510 Hull-Mounted Sonar · AN/SQR-501 CANTASS Towed Array

tile_sonar_overview.title: Sonar — Contacts, Detection Range & Ambient Noise
tile_sonar_overview.query:
timeseries {
  hull_op       = avg(`ship.sonar.hull.operational`),
  contacts      = avg(`ship.sonar.contacts.tracked`),
  range_km      = avg(`ship.sonar.detection.range.km`),
  ambient_noise = avg(`ship.sonar.ambient.noise.db`),
  hull_elements = avg(`ship.sonar.hull.active.elements`),
  hull_tx_power = avg(`ship.sonar.hull.transmit.power.kw`),
  self_noise    = avg(`ship.sonar.hull.self.noise.db`),
  water_temp    = avg(`ship.sonar.hull.water.temp.celsius`),
  salinity      = avg(`ship.sonar.hull.salinity.psu`)
}, by: {ship_id}
| filter isNull(array($ship)[0]) or in(ship_id, array($ship))

tile_sonar_raw.title: Sonar — Current Values
tile_sonar_raw.query:
timeseries {
  hullop  = avg(`ship.sonar.hull.operational`),
  ctacts  = avg(`ship.sonar.contacts.tracked`),
  range   = avg(`ship.sonar.detection.range.km`),
  anoise  = avg(`ship.sonar.ambient.noise.db`),
  wtemp   = avg(`ship.sonar.hull.water.temp.celsius`),
  sal     = avg(`ship.sonar.hull.salinity.psu`),
  towed   = avg(`ship.sonar.towed.deployed`),
  depth   = avg(`ship.sonar.towed.depth.meters`),
  tension = avg(`ship.sonar.towed.tension.newtons`),
  layback = avg(`ship.sonar.towed.layback.meters`)
}, by: {ship_id}, from: now()-5m
| filter isNull(array($ship)[0]) or in(ship_id, array($ship))
| fields ship_id,
         hull_sonar_op      = arrayLast(hullop),
         contacts_tracked   = arrayLast(ctacts),
         detection_range_km = arrayLast(range),
         ambient_noise_db   = arrayLast(anoise),
         water_temp_c       = arrayLast(wtemp),
         salinity_psu       = arrayLast(sal),
         towed_deployed     = arrayLast(towed),
         towed_depth_m      = arrayLast(depth),
         tension_newtons    = arrayLast(tension),
